They want to calculate the business class fare from the first airport in the available list to the last airport in the same list, on the last day of October 2024. Provide estimated total payable amount.

We need to get the list of all airports. Then pick first and last. Then get flight cost for travel_date 2024-10-31, travel_from first airport code, travel_to last airport code, travel_class business. That returns cost in USD. Then we need to estimate total payable amount. But we also need to consider booking? The user wants to arrange a flight on booking ID 1234. We might need to book flight? But they just want to check options and provide estimated total payable amount. So we need to compute flight cost. Then maybe add insurance? Not specified. So just flight cost.

We need to call get_flight_cost. But we need travel_from and travel_to codes. We need to get list of all airports. So call list_all_airports. Then get first and last. Then call get_flight_cost. Then provide estimated total payable amount.

We don't have access token yet. But get_flight_cost doesn't require access token. So we can call it directly. So steps:

1. Call list_all_airports to get list of airports. The function signature: list_all_airports({}). It returns presumably a list of airports with codes. We'll assume it returns something like {"airports": [{"code":"XYZ","name":"..."}]}.

2. Extract first and last airport codes.

3. Call get_flight_cost with travel_from=first_code, travel_to=last_code, travel_date="2024-10-31", travel_class="business".

4. The response will include cost. Then we can provide estimated total payable amount.

We might also need to consider booking ID 1234. But we don't need to book yet. Just estimate cost. So we can just give cost.

Thus we need to call list_all_airports.
